methods.getItemById(int id): Registry lookup: ID → Item. Returns IItemStack or Object.

methods.getServer(): Static singleton accessor. 1.7: MinecraftServer.getServer(), 1.16+: different access.
methods.worldServerForDimension(int dim): Get world by dimension ID. Returns IWorld.

methods.instance().getSide(): Get physical side (CLIENT/SERVER). Already covered by PlatformService.isPhysicalClient().

methods.readCompressed(InputStream): Read compressed NBT from stream. Returns INbt.

methods.isModLoaded(String modid): Check if a mod is loaded.

methods.getWorld(int dimensionId): Get world by dimension ID. Returns IWorld.
